mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, order_no, account_id, account_name, share_rate, share_amount, remark, create_time, update_time FROM dms_order_company_share WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_order scoped_order WHERE scoped_order.id = dms_order_company_share.order_id AND COALESCE(scoped_order.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId}) ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dms_order_company_share WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_order scoped_order WHERE scoped_order.id = dms_order_company_share.order_id AND COALESCE(scoped_order.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId})
